It also tends to begin directly with a code block rather than introductory prose, although this is not universal.
names.reasons: The unit activations and joint-write examples overwhelmingly concentrate on programming and Python function generation. Across probes 1, 2, 5, and 6, previously unannotated Python signatures become explicitly annotated, while probe 3 retains annotations already present in the original. The negative activations of the two layer-24 units promote colon-related tokens, consistent with Python annotation syntax; the C++ probe shows no comparable substantive behavioral change.

names.reasons: All five Python probes produce annotated function signatures in the edited replies, whereas four of the corresponding originals have unannotated signatures; the serialization original was already annotated. The strongest late-layer units promote colon-related tokens in their observed negative-activation direction, consistent with annotation syntax, and the joint activations overwhelmingly select code-generation contexts.
